changelog:
trpg-convert-to-briefing 1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for converting TRPG rules into a briefing_package for the TRPG AI GM engine.
- Supports automated transformation of TRPG rules into structured files: config.yaml, system_prompt.md, rules_compact.md, scenarios/*.yaml, data/*.yaml, rules_sections/*.md, and maps/*.yaml.
- Ignores intermediate and deprecated files to avoid redundant edits.
- Enforces use of Traditional Chinese for all in-game text, ensuring abbreviations include their full Chinese names.
- Optimized for single-player TRPG conversion; excludes all multiplayer-specific rules and sections.
- Introduces robust error/pause workflow: conversion halts with detailed questions if input rules are ambiguous or incompatible.
